text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  claude-code-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run Claude Code review
        env:
          CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          python claude_code_review.py

  claude-mention-handler:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && github.event.comment.body contains '@claude'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Handle @claude mention
        env:
          CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          python claude_mention_handler.py
```
